title: Rules that run
sub: Film 5 of 19 of a series on data governance: binder 9 says data quality is monitored, but monitored means a survey; the university gives every check it already runs an owner and a dimension, reads a scorecard from last night's checks, and lets each owner set the level.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side, warm umber for the people of the past. Gold is governance's decisions and a level set in advance; green is what runs and passes; amber is a warning its owner agreed to watch; red is a failure that stops what's built on it; grey hatching is what wasn't checked. Every colour is also said in words.
